title: [Issue]: Crack and suttering when playback FLAC music after upgrade from 10.8.13 to 10.9.0/10.9.1 on Android Jellyfin APP
body:
### Please describe your bug

After upgrade Jellyfin server (docker) from 10.8.13 to 10.9.0 (and now 10.9.1) when i use Jellyfin app on Android phone there are strange cracks, sutters etc when play FLAC files.
When i use dekstop app or Gelli on Android everything work fine like on 10.8.13 version.

I check also on second phone and second account. Same thing, on "old" version everything play smoothly, on "new" version crack and suttering.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Play FLAC files on Jellyfin app on Android

### Jellyfin Version

10.9.0

### if other:

10.9.1

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: DOCKER jellyfin/jellyfin on Linux Debian
- Kernel: 6.1.0-16-amd64
- Virtualization: Docker
- Clients: Jellyfin Android App
- Browser: n/a
```

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
I believe this is a Chromium issue, given I experiencied the same thing in jellyfin-vue when using it in my phone.

(On phone so can't check the code atm, just guessing) For audio normalization, we need to use a browser API called WebAudio, which allows for further processing. Probably WebAudio is used all the time now if supported for convenience, even when there is no audio normalization in place (we use it all the time in Vue as well).

In my tests, as soon as I removed WebAudio in jellyfin-vue, no stutters appeared to sound, but this is a quick test I did some time ago (probably not representative enough) and didn't found anything in Chromium bug tracker, so I let it be. If my analysis is true, then this is something that should be fixed in Chromium and it's not our duty to workaround it.

A good test in the meantime would be to check if this happen in any iOS browser and Firefox Android. 

(FYI Android app runs the web app inside Android's Web View, which is based in Chromium)
